name: Hexa ~Nikuyoku no Hatsukakan~
source:
Main character takes the same train home every day, because there are always same six cute women in the same train. He likes to see how their appearance changes daily. However, his fun is about to end in 20 days with transfer to another town. And he takes the courage and becomes proactive towards them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公每天下班都会固定搭乘同一班电车回家，只因车厢里总能见到那六位俏丽的女性，暗自欣赏她们每日变换的穿搭成了他的日常乐趣。然而二十天后他便要被调往外地，这份小小的乐趣眼看即将画上句号；于是他终于鼓起勇气，决定主动向她们出击。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
